data.one_liner: Jaspr plugin for building content-driven sites like documentation and blogs.
data.what_it_does: Provides tools for loading, parsing, and rendering content from markdown files and other sources for Jaspr web applications. Includes support for frontmatter, templating, layouts, built-in components, and theming.
use_when: You are building a content-driven site like a blog or documentation using Jaspr.
You need to parse markdown files, frontmatter, and use templates with Jaspr components.
avoid_when: You are not using Jaspr for your web application.
You are building a standard mobile application.
strengths: Fully customizable with your own implementations and components.
Built-in support for layouts and dark/light theming.
weaknesses: Strictly tied to the Jaspr web framework ecosystem.
Documentation is external and hosted on specific site links.
